help.extraArea: Add for example an alcove, a hallway or skirting already measured in m².
help.waste: Margin for cuts, breakage and adjustments. Typical value, adapt it to your site.
help.packaging: Shown on the packaging or the product page.
help.price: Leave empty if the price is unknown: the cost will be shown as unavailable.
help.coverage: Coverage per coat given by the manufacturer (m² per litre).
help.dosage: Dosage to be confirmed for the intended use and your site's specifications.
help.recipe: Editable reference recipe; leave empty to calculate cement only.
help.upstand: Waterproofing turned up onto the surrounding walls.
help.consumption: Take this value from the data sheet of the chosen product.
help.openings: Total area of doors and windows, in m².
help.compaction: Allowance for settlement of the placed material.
help.density: Only a value confirmed by the supplier. Without density, no tonnage is calculated.
help.truck: Volume carried per trip, if known.
help.tilesPerM2: Roof tile manufacturer's data (depends on the gauge).

assumptions.indicative: Indicative estimate: excluding delivery, labour, installation and taxes.
assumptions.tileWaste: The waste margin covers cuts and breakage; it increases with offset, diagonal or herringbone layouts.
assumptions.tilePattern: The diagram is a layout preview, not an executable cutting plan.
assumptions.packagingCheck: The number of boxes is rounded up; check the product's actual packaging.
assumptions.openingsStandard: Openings deducted using standard sizes (door 0.90 × 2.10 m, window 1.20 × 1.00 m).
assumptions.coverageCheck: Coverage depends on the surface and product: use the value from the data sheet.
assumptions.surfacePrep: Primers and surface preparation are not counted.
assumptions.dosageUser: The dosage is the one you choose; it must match the intended use.
assumptions.recipeReference: The sand/gravel/water recipe is an editable common reference, not a universal mix.
assumptions.notStructural: This is not a structural calculation: have any load-bearing work validated by a qualified professional.
assumptions.consumptionDatasheet: Consumption must come from the data sheet of the product used.
assumptions.upstands: Upstands are calculated along the entire perimeter of the surface.
assumptions.supportPrep: Primers, reinforcing strips and accessories are not included.
assumptions.notchTrowel: Adhesive consumption varies with the notched trowel size and tile format.
assumptions.jointIncluded: The number of blocks per m² accounts for the joint thickness.
assumptions.noMortar: Laying mortar and tie beams are not counted.
assumptions.stoneWaste: Natural stone often needs a higher margin (veining, sizing, cuts).
assumptions.stoneVeining: For matched-vein layouts, allow an extra margin.
assumptions.densitySupplier: Tonnage is only calculated with a density confirmed by the supplier.
assumptions.compactionFactor: Bulking is an estimated allowance; it varies with the material and compaction.
assumptions.boardVsPlaster: Sheets are calculated from their dimensions and a cutting margin, not from filler consumption.
assumptions.paverCuts: Offset, herringbone or diagonal layouts generate more cuts.
assumptions.borders: Edging, bedding sand and geotextile are not included.
assumptions.tilesPerM2Maker: The number of tiles per m² depends on the model and gauge: manufacturer data.
assumptions.roofNoStructure: No check of the roof structure, loads or watertightness is performed.
